newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi to spend $196 mln to repair rain damages.
newsitem.headline: Saudi to spend $196 mln to repair rain damages.

text.p: Saudi Arabia will spend 735 million riyals ($196 million) to repair damages caused by freak rain storms and to improve wastewater systems, Al-Eqtisadiah newspaper reported on Wednesday.
It said the estimate by the communications ministry includes repairs to road networks, building a new sewerage system and a number of dams.

Heavy rains hit the Red Sea coastal areas of the kingdom last month, killing at least three people, cutting off many villages, sweeping away several homes and cars and disrupting nearly 21,000 telephone lines in the area.
Saudi newspapers on Tuesday put damages to property and infrastructure at around 90 million riyals ($24 million).
Saudis will pray for rain across the kingdom on Thursday in response to an appeal by King Fahd. ($1=3.75 riyals)
